text: On my right hand. <break time="0.8s" /> There were lines of fishing stakes. <break time="0.8s" /> Mysterious in their purpose. <break time="0.8s" /> And on my left. <break time="0.8s" /> A group of barren islets. <break time="0.8s" /> Lay upon a sea. <break time="0.8s" /> So still that it seemed solid. <break time="0.8s" /> My ship lay at anchor. <break time="0.8s" /> At the head of the Gulf of Siam. <break time="0.8s" /> And the only other sign of human life. <break time="0.8s" /> Was the masts of a ship. <break time="0.8s" /> Anchored inside the islands. <break time="0.8s" /> Half hidden by the land. <break time="0.8s" /> Appointed to this command. <break time="0.8s" /> Only a fortnight before I was a stranger to the ship. <break time="0.8s" /> And, if all the truth must be told. <break time="0.8s" /> Somewhat of a stranger to myself. <break time="0.8s" /> Not only was I new to the ship. <break time="0.8s" /> But her officers and crew. <break time="0.8s" /> Had been together for eighteen months. <break time="0.8s" /> So that I alone was the outsider on board. <break time="0.8s" /> Watched by every man. <break time="0.8s" /> On that first evening. <break time="0.8s" /> I wondered how far. <break time="0.8s" /> I should turn out faithful. <break time="0.8s" /> To that ideal conception. <break time="0.8s" /> Of ones own personality. <break time="0.8s" /> Which every man sets up. <break time="0.8s" /> For himself secretly. <break time="0.8s" /> Wishing to know my ship. <break time="0.8s" /> And, perhaps, to steady my own nerves. <break time="0.8s" /> I did a thing. <break time="0.8s" /> Unusual for a captain. <break time="0.8s" /> Sending all hands to rest. <break time="0.8s" /> And keeping the anchor watch myself. <break time="0.8s" /> Pacing the deck alone. <break time="0.8s" /> I noticed that the rope side ladder. <break time="0.8s" /> Which should have been hauled in had been left hanging over the side. <break time="0.8s" /> And I went to pull it up. <break time="0.8s" /> But the ladder would not come. <break time="0.8s" /> And, looking over the rail. <break time="0.8s" /> I saw in the faint glow of the water. <break time="0.8s" /> A naked man. <break time="0.8s" /> Whose body seemed silvery and ghostly. <break time="0.8s" /> Holding the lowest rung.
